# Rest at every resolution

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`rest-at-every-resolution` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](rest-at-every-resolution.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The natural-number unit is a quantum of loss. Without counting the refinement, loss in proportion sets the least bound on what an enclosed family exchanges and, with a least size, bounds the times of exchange, growth, fall, arising and ceasing; a least fall of the reserve bounds the end it defers.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The spine counts amounts in natural numbers of one fixed unit, so dissipation loses at least a unit at every exchange, and the rest and openness laws rely on that quantum.
2. With the splitting of the unit counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added (rest-with-refinement-counted); the laws here are those without counting the refinement, kept as research notes.
3. Let the unit split into r t finer units across the step from t (with r constantly one it is Balances), and let R count the units of each step, the unit of step T being one. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesAt`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances`, `Becoming.Flow.balancesAt_one`)
4. The loss law: where across each step from T on q times what remains together with k quanta is within q times what was there, the quanta counted since T number at most q times the quantity at T. (`Becoming.losses_invariant`, `Becoming.losses_bound`)
5. So, balanced at a refining resolution and dissipative, a family without repetition closed from T on loses at least 1/q of the unit of step T at no more steps than q times its stock, and losing so does not recur; with the unit fixed, taking from a closed family does not recur. (`Becoming.Flow.quantum_bound`, `Becoming.Flow.quantum_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_not_recurring`)
6. Loss in proportion: every closed family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it; so it is where each formation gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes. (`Becoming.Flow.DissipativeBy`, `Becoming.Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each`)
7. With loss in proportion the amount law holds at every resolution: everything taken from a family without repetition closed from T on, each step's amount counted in the unit of step T, is at most q + 1 times its stock at T, and everything given back at most q times. (`Becoming.refinedSum`, `Becoming.refinedSum_invariant`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake_bound`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment_bound`)
8. In a world with a census, embodied relata and every step from T on enclosed, everything taken from what stands is at most q + 1 times the total standing at T, and everything given to what stands at most q times. (`Becoming.World.taken_bound`, `Becoming.World.given_bound`)
9. The bound is the least: in Geometric one formation takes the whole of a closed pool at each step and gives back q/(q+1) of it, at a unit splitting into q + 1 at each step, and everything taken comes within 1/m of q + 1 times the pool for every m. (`Becoming.amount_sharp`)
10. Every count of a size follows from the amount law: where each step's count is within p times an amount, the count since T is within p times the amount's bound. (`Becoming.counts_of_amounts`)
11. The exchange law: the formations taking at least 1/p of the unit from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times its stock at T. (`Becoming.Flow.exchange_bound`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring`)
12. The growth law: in a world with a census, embodied relata and every step from T on enclosed, the relata gaining at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p q times the total standing at T, so such gains do not recur and nothing arises at that size at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.World.growth_bound`, `Becoming.World.growth_not_recurring`, `Becoming.World.arising_not_recurring`)
13. The fall law: the relata falling by at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times the total standing at T, so nothing standing at least 1/p of the unit ceases at arbitrarily late steps: at every resolution neither arising nor ceasing at that size recurs. (`Becoming.World.fall_bound`, `Becoming.World.fall_not_recurring`, `Becoming.World.ceasing_not_recurring`, `Becoming.World.not_recurring_at_resolution`)
14. Reserve: where each active step beyond support lowers the reserve by at least 1/p of the unit, a formation unsupported from T on is active at most p times its reserve at T; the spine's reserve is the case of p one at a fixed unit, and the reading in a refining unit that asks only that the reserve fall is, with the unit fixed, the spine's reserve. (`Becoming.Web.CarriesAt`, `Becoming.Web.CarriesAt.lasts`, `Becoming.Web.Carries.carriesAt`, `Becoming.Web.CarriesIn`, `Becoming.Web.carriesIn_one`)
15. A least loss at each size: with the spine's dissipation, where each formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it, such takings from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most m times its stock at T; loss in proportion at each transfer gives such a least loss. (`Becoming.Flow.LosesAtSize`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_bound_of_least_loss`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring_of_least_loss`, `Becoming.Flow.losesAtSize_of_each`)
16. Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain, and bounding the amount exchanged, needs more. (`Becoming.growth_needs_proportion`, `Becoming.throughput_needs_proportion`)
17. Without any one of these premises change can continue without end; the witnesses are each balanced at a unit splitting without end and dissipative. Asymptote, losing all it takes and so dissipative in every proportion, is taken from without end exactly where the unit splits without end, and does not balance at the fixed unit. (`Becoming.rest_needs_quantum`, `Becoming.Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff`, `Becoming.Asymptote.not_balanced`)
18. Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative in no proportion. (`Becoming.exchange_needs_quantum`)
19. Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after, and does not balance at the fixed unit. (`Becoming.arising_needs_quantum`, `Becoming.Emission.not_balanced`)
20. Alternation, with a census, embodied relata and every step enclosed, has two sides hold and arise with one whole unit of step 0 in turn, is dissipative in no proportion, and does not balance at the fixed unit. (`Becoming.arising_needs_proportion`, `Becoming.Alternation.not_balanced`)
21. In Dwindle, at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve falling in the finer unit at each and tending to one unit of step 0, with no fall of the reserve by 1/p of the unit at each active step for any p. (`Becoming.reserve_needs_quantum`)
22. In Trickle, at a unit quartering at each step, a whole unit of step 0 passes between two sides in ever more, ever smaller transfers, each losing two units of the step after, so every size has a least loss and transfers of each fixed size stop, yet a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no proportion lost. (`Becoming.growth_needs_proportion`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Resolution: R T = 1 and, from T on, R (t + 1) = r t · R t with 0 < r t, so the unit only splits; amounts at each step stay natural numbers of that step's unit. These are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.
- Loss in proportion (Flow.DissipativeBy q): on every family without repetition closed across a step, the family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it; it holds where each formation taking part gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes (Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each), not conversely.
- It is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit loss, not derived; the author reads it as an upper bound on the efficiency of the family's exchanges taken together.
- On 11 October 2026 Ren chose a least difference at every exchange (‘A is right’) and did not take this as a premise of the theory; the line is kept as research notes (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md).
- The exchange law at a least loss: the spine's dissipation (each formation taking gives a closed family back at least one unit of the step after less than it takes; the proof uses only that it gives no more than it takes) and a least loss at each size (Flow.LosesAtSize: a formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it, m the same at every step).
- The world laws: a census of activity, every relatum embodied and every step from T on enclosed, as in the rest theorem (continued-change-needs-openness). The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on.
- The reserve law: unsupported from T on; activity decidable. The least fall of the reserve (at least 1/p of the unit at each active step) is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit fall; with the refinement counted, wherever it gives the reserve nothing the reserve is the spine's (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined, see rest-with-refinement-counted).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Amounts are rationals by refinement, the unit never coarsening, with neither real amounts nor continuous time.
- The amount law's bound is the least, while whether the counting bounds are attained is not proved in the core: the review's probe Tight.attained attains the exchange bound at p = q = S = 1 and is not moved into the core. Witness: `Becoming.amount_sharp`.
- The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on, not read of worlds with changing enclosures.
- Loss in proportion and the least fall of the reserve are premises not taken for the theory, kept as research notes.
- A premise weaker than the family's proportion that still gives the growth law is given by the review's probes (ReplenishedLoses), not moved into the core.
- The witnesses are small: Asymptote, Circulation and Dwindle have one relatum, Alternation two, and Emission adds one at every step; the conduits of Trickle are not active.
- Each witness shows the premise it lacks is needed given the others, not that all premises are mutually independent, and none describes an actual system.
- ‘Does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens.
- **Counterexample:** Asymptote: losing all it takes, dissipative in every proportion, the pool closed and the drawer supported at every step; taking continues without end exactly where the unit splits without end (Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff), what is taken shrinking below every quantum, and the flow does not balance at the fixed unit (Asymptote.not_balanced). So the least size cannot be dropped. Counted, the refinement feeds it (refinement_feeds_witnesses). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Circulation: what stands listed, balanced at a halving unit, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, one whole unit of step 0 exchanged at every step; by the exchange law it is dissipative in no proportion (Circulation.not_dissipativeBy). So that the exchange does not recur with a fixed unit (World.exchange_not_recurring) relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion cannot be dropped. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Emission: meets every premise of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, and is dissipative in proportion (giving back half of what it takes), with a new relatum arising at every step, standing at one unit of the step after; the world does not balance at the fixed unit (Emission.not_balanced). So the rest theorem relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion without a least size does not suffice. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Alternation: meets every premise of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, the two sides arising with one whole unit of step 0 in turn; by the growth law it is dissipative in no proportion (Alternation.not_dissipativeBy), and the world does not balance at the fixed unit (Alternation.not_balanced). So a least size without loss in proportion does not suffice. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Dwindle: at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve, 2^t + 1 in the unit of step t, falling in the finer unit at each step (Dwindle.carriesIn) and tending from above to one unit of step 0, never reaching zero; for no p does each active step lower the reserve by 1/p of the unit (Dwindle.not_carriesAt, reserve_needs_quantum). With the unit fixed such a reserve is the spine's (Web.carriesIn_one), which Web.Carries.lasts forbids. So that a reserve defers the end without escaping it relies on the quantum, and at every resolution needs a least fall of the reserve at each active step; counted, the refinement gives this reserve something at every step (refinement_feeds_witnesses). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Trickle: at a unit quartering at each step, two sides hold one whole unit of step 0 in turn, and at step t it passes to the other side in 2^t parts carried by 2^t conduits standing at nothing (Trickle.conduits), each part losing two units of the step after. It has a census, embodied relata, balance, dissipation and every step enclosed; every size has a least loss (Trickle.losesAtEverySize) and transfers of each fixed size do not recur (Trickle.exchange_not_recurring); a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no proportion lost (Trickle.not_dissipativeBy, growth_needs_proportion). Everything taken from the two sides grows past every multiple of the unit of step 0 (Trickle.throughput_unbounded, throughput_needs_proportion). So a least loss at each size gives the exchange law but neither the growth law nor the amount law; an independent review's probes show that what Trickle uses is unboundedly many transfers within one step (growth_needs_bounded_transfers, not moved into the core). The conduits are not active; a variant in which only active formations take is not constructed. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Stated for discrete steps. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The rest theorem with a fixed unit (continued-change-needs-openness) is the case r = 1 with the spine's one-unit loss; this result shows that the loss there is a quantum carried by the unit and gives the laws holding at every resolution without counting the refinement. On 11 October 2026 Ren said that a least difference at every exchange belongs to becoming itself (‘A is right - because of change, there is difference’) and asked about the case of zero premises (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md); with the splitting of the unit counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added, and the witnesses of this record are each fed by the refinement (rest-with-refinement-counted). The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): without counting the refinement, the total standing counted in the unit of step T is a rational quantity, refining the unit representing amounts at finer resolution; loss in proportion is an upper bound on efficiency; 1/p is the size at which change is counted. On this reading, with bounded efficiency, enclosed generation of any fixed size stops, and inside an enclosure it can continue only ever finer or ever closer to lossless. This answers, for rational amounts and discrete steps, the next step of continued-change-needs-openness, ‘total standing with rates or continuous amounts’; continuous time and real amounts remain open. Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain needs more than a least loss at each size of transfer, since a whole unit can pass in ever more, ever smaller transfers (Trickle). A premise on the family's totals is immune to splitting: so is the proportion, and so is the fifteenth independent review's probe ReplenishedLoses (a closed family given at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it), which is strictly weaker than the proportion and still gives the growth law; what splitting defeats is a premise per transfer. This passage earlier said that counting what relata gain ‘needs the family's share’ and that ‘only a loss in proportion to what is transferred cannot be split away’; both overclaimed necessity and are corrected following W1 of the fifteenth independent review. Ren on the research notes (11 October 2026): ‘they seem to be good research subjects, but this is separate matter, we can leave a note’.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [continued-change-needs-openness](continued-change-needs-openness.md). Reuses the census of what stands and its stock (Web.StandingCensus, Web.StandingCensus.stock_eq, World.standingCensus), steps enclosed around what stands (Flow.AroundStanding, Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not) and the holder of exposed (Exposed.stands_iff, Exposed.holder_one); the boundary theorems match the premises of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed, World.arising_opens and World.exchange_not_recurring.
  - Output: Across a step enclosed around what stands, the total standing equals the stock of the enclosing family; an enclosed step cannot be refuted to be enclosed around what stands.
  - Input: At a refining resolution the total standing does not rise, and each gain of at least 1/p of the unit makes it lose at least 1/(p q) of the unit.
  - Preserved conditions: A census of activity; every relatum embodied; every step from T on enclosed; balance at a refining resolution; loss in proportion. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [no-finite-part-bears-taking](no-finite-part-bears-taking.md). Reuses dissipation and closed families (Flow.DissipatesOn, Flow.Dissipative, Flow.ClosedAt, Flow.Enclosed), that a family dissipated on has replenishment and takers within its uptake (DissipatesOn.replenishment_takers), that with finitely many relata every step is enclosed (Flow.enclosed_of_finite), and the comparison of totals between supports (total_le_of_support); the fixed-unit case matches Flow.Balances.taking_not_recurring.
  - Output: A family dissipated on has its replenishment together with its takers within its uptake.
  - Input: At a refining resolution, the stock together with the takers is within r t times the stock before (Flow.BalancesAt.lowers).
  - Preserved conditions: Balance at a refining resolution; dissipation; a closed family without repetition. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [reserve-defers-ending](reserve-defers-ending.md). Reuses the reserve Web.Carries; Web.Carries.carriesAt shows the spine's reserve is the reserve at every resolution with p one at a fixed unit, and Web.carriesIn_one that the reading in a refining unit is it when the unit is fixed; Web.CarriesAt.lasts is the form of Web.Carries.lasts at every resolution.
  - Output: Across an unsupported step the reserve does not rise, and falls where the formation is active.
  - Input: Across an unsupported step the reserve does not rise in the finer unit, and falls by at least 1/p of the unit where the formation is active.
  - Preserved conditions: Unsupported from T on; the unit only refines; activity decidable. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [counting-under-enclosure](counting-under-enclosure.md). There enclosure bounds change, counted in the unit; this result bounds gains and taking of at least 1/p of the unit at every resolution, with loss in proportion in place of the unit's quantum.
- related, not a proved adapter: [theory-of-becoming-foundation](theory-of-becoming-foundation.md). Plan R1: one dimension of the representation's scope, the unit of amounts; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.
- related, not a proved adapter: [rest-with-refinement-counted](rest-with-refinement-counted.md). There the splitting of the unit is counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added, and this record's witnesses are fed by the refinement; this record gives the laws without counting it.

### History

- 2026-10-10: added as R1 of the unification plan, following Ren's ‘let's push as far as possible and if we see a stronger claim that can be make and is important, give it a try. we push pareto frontier’ and ‘keep going please, agree with direction’ (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-10-pareto-frontier.md); answers, for rational amounts, the next step of continued-change-needs-openness; see section 59 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-10 R1b: under the same resolution and premises, adds the laws of falling and ceasing (World.fall_bound, World.ceasing_not_recurring) and rest at every resolution (World.rests_at_resolution), the reserve at every resolution (Web.CarriesAt, Web.CarriesAt.lasts, Web.carriesIn_one) and the witness Dwindle (reserve_needs_quantum); adds the dependency reserve-defers-ending; see section 59.1 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-10 R2: Flow.DissipatesBy restated for the family (the family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it), the per-formation form giving it through Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each, so every law keeps its statement under a weaker premise; adds the exchange law at a least loss for each size (Flow.LosesAtSize, Flow.exchange_bound_of_least_loss) and the witness Trickle (growth_needs_proportion); see section 59.2 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-11 R3: adds the amount law (refinedSum, refinedSum_invariant, Flow.uptake_bound, Flow.replenishment_bound, World.taken_bound, World.given_bound) and that its bound is the least (Geometric, amount_sharp); the exchange, growth and fall laws are now proved from the amount law through counts_of_amounts, their statements unchanged; in Trickle everything taken grows without bound (throughput_needs_proportion); see section 59.3 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-11 R4: integrates the fifteenth independent review (BECOMING-R1-R2-REVIEW.md): corrects the overclaimed necessity (W1), the dissipation missing from the quantum law (W4), the gloss of dissipation in the least-loss exchange law (W5), quantifiers and scope (W8: ‘can continue without end’, ‘rest at each size’), the witnesses' relata (W9), names (W10: the least fall of the reserve, proportion, Trickle's conduits) and the provenance of readings; the boundary theorems add that the witnesses do not balance at the fixed unit (Asymptote.not_balanced, Emission.not_balanced, Alternation.not_balanced); following Ren's choice of A on 11 October 2026, this record holds the research notes without counting the refinement, the line counting it being rest-with-refinement-counted; see section 59.4 of the integration note.
